desc:
• CEREAL BARS: You don’t always need a bowl to crunch into your favorite cereals; Now transformed into a portable snack with Lucky Charms Cereal Bars

  • PERFECTLY PORTABLE: These individually wrapped bars are the perfect on-the-go breakfast snack your whole family will love; Value Pack with 16 cereal bars in total

  • LUNCH BOX AND PANTRY FAVORITE: A portable snack perfect for the pantry, lunch box, and breakfast treat

  • KIDS SNACKS: Fun cereal bars for school snack time or an on-the-go invigorating treat; Packed with the cereal crunch and flavor kids and adults love

  • CONTAINS: 16 ct
features:
Features

Only 100 Calories Per Bar
A low-calorie snack that satisfies your sweet tooth without overindulgence.

Made with Whole Grain Oats and Marshmallows
Brings the crunch and color of classic Lucky Charms into every bite.

Good Source of Calcium
Each bar provides approximately 10–15% of the daily recommended calcium intake.

Individually Wrapped
Perfect for lunchboxes, road trips, or a quick snack on the go.

Simple, Familiar Ingredients
Contains ingredients you recognize—cereal, marshmallows, and a creamy drizzle. 

 Benefits

Nostalgic Fun for All Ages
A treat that brings back childhood memories while still appealing to adults.

Portable and Ready to Eat
Great for busy mornings, afternoon pick-me-ups, or anytime snacking.

Balanced Snacking Option
Offers portion control and a touch of sweetness without going overboard.

Kid-Friendly
Loved by children for the marshmallows and fun appearance; easy to pack in school lunches.

Boost of Calcium
Helps support bone health as part of a balanced diet.
ingredients: Cereal (whole grain oats, sugar, corn syrup, corn starch, salt, calcium carbonate, trisodium phosphate, canola oil, natural and artificial flavor. Vitamin E (mixed tocopherols) added to preserve freshness. Vitamins and Minerals: calcium carbonate, Vitamin C (Sodium Ascorbate), iron and zinc (mineral nutrients), A B Vitamin (Niacinamide), Vitamin B6 (Pyridoxine Hydrochloride), Vitamin B1 (Thiamin Mononitrate), Vitamin A (palmitate), Vitamin B2 (Riboflavin), A B Vitamin (folic acid), Vitamin B12, Vitamin D3), Corn Syrup, Confectionery Coating (sugar, palm kernel oil, whey powder, soy lecithin), Marshmallows (sugar, corn starch, corn syrup, dextrose, gelatin, color (red 40, yellow 5, blue 1, yellow 6), artificial flavor), Crisp Rice (rice flour, barley malt extract, Salt), Canola Oil, Fructose, High Fructose Corn Syrup, Sugar. Contains 2 % or less of: Vegetable Glycerin, Maltodextrin, Calcium Carbonate, Sorbitol, Water, Gelatin, Salt, Soy Lecithin, Artificial Flavor.
